latin: Rationes quas adducunt peripatetici ad probandum quod in causis essentialiter ordinatis non eatur in infinitum, non conuincunt de necessitate falsitatem positi.
translation: The arguments that the Peripatetics bring forward to prove that one cannot proceed to infinity among essentially ordered causes do not necessarily demonstrate the falsity of the position that one can.
